newsitem.title: FINLAND: Konecranes 4-mth profit seen at FIM 42 mln.
newsitem.headline: Konecranes 4-mth profit seen at FIM 42 mln.

text.p: Some Finnish equities analysts revised their forecasts for cranes maker KCI Konecranes Oy's four-month profit after the company last week said some of them had not understood the seasonality of its profit accumulation.

Konecranes on May 21 released a statement saying analysts predicting a January-April profit considerably over the 1996 first tertial "have not fully understood the steep seasonality of KCI Konecranes' revenue and profit accumulation".
A Reuters poll had found a median forecast January-April profit before extras and tax of 46.5 million markka in a 33-67 million range against 36.2 million in the year-ago period.
Konecranes Chief Financial Officer Eero Odelma on May 21 told Reuters by telephone that in the recent past, about 15 percent of the company's full-year profit had been generated in the first tertial.
Konecranes also said it agreed with the full-year 1997 median forecast profit of 250 million markka (vs 208.2 million in 1996) by the analysts in the Reuters poll.
The median of nine analysts' forecasts in a new poll made after Konecranes' comments on the previous poll was 42 million markka in a 30-51 million markka range.
Konecranes' January-April results are due for publication on May 29 at 1000/0700 GMT.
